sql-tap.purpose: Inspect an explicitly configured local SQL diagnostic proxy. Captures private query text and bound parameters. Synthetic PostgreSQL/MySQL PDO compatibility passed; no production routing or execution admission is implied.

sql-tapd.purpose: Optional on-demand PostgreSQL/MySQL protocol diagnostic proxy. Bind proxy, gRPC and HTTP to loopback; preserve direct application connections unless a scoped diagnostic run explicitly selects the proxy. EXPLAIN credentials remain absent by default.

plos-archify.purpose: Render offline PLOS architecture diagrams from explicit JSON sources.

plos-pdf.purpose: Extract local PDF text and page coordinates; retain existing extraction fallback.

plos-hister.purpose: Search or explicitly import the selected local reference collection. No automatic browser collection.

docker.purpose: Observe the installed container client. Discovery grants no container execution permissions.
